cell_type.evidence: The I27E24C–K55C monomer samples were prepared by diluting 20 μl of protein (0.5 μg μl−1) in 20 μl PBS pH 7.4 containing L-cysteine, homocysteine and N-acetyl cysteine at the same concentration as used in the single molecule experiments.

material_type.evidence: The (I27E24C–K55C)8 and (I27G32C–A75C)8 polyproteins were constructed using the BamHI, BglII and KpnI restriction sites (polyprotein sequences shown in Supplementary Table 2).
